announcements.headline: EQS-Adhoc: ProSiebenSat.1 Media SE expects a slight decline in organic revenues but reaffirms EBITDA growth outlook
announcements.insight: The announcement indicates a guidance change where organic revenue is expected to decline while EBITDA growth is reaffirmed, signaling mixed financial performance that may influence investor sentiment.

announcements.headline: EQS-AFR: ProSiebenSat.1 Media SE: Preliminary announcement of the publication of quarterly reports and quarterly/interim statements
announcements.insight: This is a standard administrative notice confirming the release schedule for quarterly reports, lacking immediate price-sensitive data. For ProSiebenSat.1, market attention will focus on whether these filings reveal margin pressures from rising content costs or successful ad revenue recovery in the German broadcasting sector.

announcements.headline: EQS-AFR: ProSiebenSat.1 Media SE: Preliminary announcement of the publication of financial reports according to Articles 114, 115, 117 of the WpHG [the German Securities Act]
announcements.insight: This is a standard regulatory filing confirming the release of statutory accounts rather than a substantive operational update or financial result; for ProsiebenSat.1, market attention remains fixed on its ongoing strategic pivot toward digital streaming and advertising efficiency rather than routine reporting.
